A ten-week text for CMSC 270 at Lawrence University

Where Things Live

Data Structures in Modern C++

First draft edition, Fall 2026

Where does it live?layout and ownership in memory
What does it promise?interface and invariants
What does it cost?on paper and on real hardware
How do you know?tests, tools, and measurement

Start reading PDF edition

  1. Read This FirstWhat this book is, the four questions it keeps asking, and how to learn with (and without) a language model.
  2. Chapter 1Week 1Memory Is the MaterialC++ from the ground up. Objects are bytes; variables are places; pointers are addresses. The stack, the heap, and the tools that catch you when you fall.
  3. Chapter 2Week 2What Does It Cost?Counting steps, growth rates, and Big-O. Binary search and its invariant. Measuring real programs, and the first hint that the machine has opinions.
  4. Chapter 3Week 3Building a VectorWe build std::vector. Class invariants, RAII, copying and moving, templates, iterators, amortized analysis, and a testing method we will reuse all term.
  5. Chapter 4Week 4Links, Stacks, and QueuesThe other way to arrange memory. Linked lists, stacks, queues, ring buffers, and an honest look at what caches do to pointer-chasing.
  6. Chapter 5Week 5HashingThe workhorse of modern software. Hash functions, chaining, open addressing, load factors, adversarial inputs, and Bloom filters.
  7. Chapter 6Week 6Recursion and TreesRecursion as a habit of thought. Binary trees, traversals, binary search trees, ownership with unique_ptr, and the problem of shape.
  8. Chapter 7Week 7BalanceRotations and AVL trees, then the family: red-black trees, B-trees, and what an ordered map buys you that a hash table cannot.
  9. Chapter 8Week 8Heaps and SortingA tree that lives in an array. Priority queues, heapsort, mergesort, quicksort, the n log n barrier, and what std::sort really does.
  10. Chapter 9Week 9GraphsRelationships as data. Representations, breadth-first and depth-first search, Dijkstra's algorithm, and union-find.
  11. Chapter 10Week 10Data Structures in the WildChoosing and combining structures. LRU caches, tries, tokenizers, database indexes, Git, vector search, and what comes next.
  12. Appendix AThe ToolchainCompiling, warnings, sanitizers, and reading the error messages.
  13. Appendix BA Little MathematicsLogarithms, sums, induction, and a little probability.
  14. Appendix CA Field Guide to the Standard ContainersCosts, invalidation rules, and idioms for the standard containers.
  15. How This Book Was MadeHow this book was made, and how far to trust it.
  16. BibliographyEvery source cited, in one list.
